claims: Conan O'Brien is hosting the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Conan O'Brien's hosting of the 98th Academy Awards marks his second consecutive year as host.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is held at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony broadcasts on ABC.
Conan O'Brien opened the 98th Academy Awards show with a pre-taped parody.
Conan O'Brien appeared in drag as "Aunt Gladys" from the film "Weapons".
Conan O'Brien's monologue featured jokes about the Oscars moving to YouTube, says SF Chronicle.
Conan O'Brien's monologue featured jokes about artificial intelligence, says SF Chronicle.
Conan O'Brien's monologue featured a roast of Timothée Chalamet's recent comments on ballet and opera, says SF Chronicle.
The 98th Academy Awards focused on celebrating "global artistry, collaboration, patience, resilience and... optimism," as noted by the New York Times.
